kvkk.title: Personal data protection (KVKK)
kvkk.cloud: With a cloud provider, customer names, phone numbers, plates and amounts the assistant uses to answer are sent to the selected provider ({{provider}}). Make sure your users are informed and the required privacy notices are in place.
kvkk.local: With a local OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, vLLM) data is only sent to that server. Make sure it runs on your own infrastructure.
form.section_provider_hint: Which AI service the assistant uses.
form.api_key_hint: Stored encrypted and never sent back to the browser.
form.api_key_optional_hint: Usually not needed for local servers. Stored encrypted.
form.api_key_placeholder_replace: Paste a new key to replace it
form.api_key_clear_pending: The key will be removed when you save
form.base_url_hint_anthropic: Leave empty unless you use a gateway or proxy.
form.model_hint: Default claude-opus-5. For a local provider, the model name on the server (e.g. qwen2.5:14b).
form.title_model_hint: Cheap model that writes conversation titles (Anthropic). Empty uses the main model.
form.effort_hint: Higher effort is more careful but slower and more expensive. Low/medium is recommended for everyday chat.
form.max_tokens_hint: 256–128000. Longer answers are cut off at this limit.
form.feature_chat_hint: Master switch. When off, organizations cannot see the assistant.
form.feature_charts_hint: The assistant can draw charts in the chat.
form.feature_actions_hint: Create/update records through confirmation cards (next phase).
form.feature_voice_hint: Push-to-talk questions and read-aloud replies. Requires a Speaches URL.
form.section_tools_hint: The assistant only sees a tool when the user has the matching permission. Turn tools off entirely here.
form.section_instructions_hint: Appended to the system prompt for every organization.
form.extra_instructions_placeholder: E.g. Always state amounts including VAT.
form.section_quota_hint: Monthly token limit per organization (input + output + cache writes). 0 means unlimited; override per organization on its detail page.
form.section_voice_hint: Speech-to-text (faster-whisper) and read-aloud (Piper) run on your own Speaches server; recordings are not sent to third parties.
form.voice_base_url_hint: Address on the Docker network, e.g. http://app-speaches:8000 (a trailing /v1 is optional).
form.voice_language_hint: Recognition language (ISO code, e.g. tr). Leave empty to auto-detect.
form.voice_stt_model_hint: Defaults to Systran/faster-whisper-small. More accurate but slower: Systran/faster-whisper-medium.
form.voice_tts_voice_hint: Speaches TTS model. Piper voices are named in the model id; for other models use model:voice.
form.test_hint: Sends a tiny request to the provider with the saved settings.
voice_test.hint: Connects to Speaches with the values in the form (even unsaved) and checks that the models are installed.
voice_test.models_missing: The server is reachable but some models are not installed.
voice_test.download_hint: To download the missing models on the server (once; may take a few minutes):
